rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for school or university grounds and, by extension, their community or atmosphere.

example.english: I really like this university's campus atmosphere.
example.traditional: 我幾鍾意呢間大學嘅校園氣氛。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gei2 zung1 ji3 ni1 gaan1 daai6 hok6 ge3 haau6 jyun4 hei3 fan1

rows.note: Use this when stressing a distinct, bounded school or university site, especially one of several campuses.

example.english: This university has three campuses; this is the main campus.
example.traditional: 呢間大學有三個校區，呢個係主校區。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 daai6 hok6 jau5 saam1 go3 haau6 keoi1 ni1 go3 hai6 zyu2 haau6 keoi1

rows.note: Use this for the grounds or complex of a business or other non-school organization rather than an educational campus.

example.english: There’s a café inside our company campus.
example.traditional: 我哋公司個園區入面有咖啡店。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 go3 jyun4 keoi1 jap6 min6 jau5 gaa3 fe1 dim3
